jobs.title: AI Governance Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Dentsu is operationalizing AI at scale. Across every brand and practice, business teams are identifying AI\-powered tools, platforms, and vendors they want to deploy — and they need a fast, expert path through the governance process to do it safely. The AI Governance Concierge Service is dentsu's answer to that challenge — a dedicated, end\-to\-end service that gives any Americas business team a single expert point of contact for AI product adoption. The AI Governance Engineer is the process navigator, program manager, and technical implementer of the service. Working in close coordination with the AI Governance Service Lead, the Governance Engineer receives each submission package approved by the Lead, thoroughly understands its contents — the business case, the vendor research, the risk profile, and the policy alignment — and takes full ownership of driving it through the cross\-functional review process. The Engineer is expected to speak to the details of every submission they manage, serve as the knowledgeable point of contact for all reviewing functions, coordinate with the Analyst when additional research or documentation is needed, and own the end\-to\-end implementation once approval is granted. This role ensures nothing stalls, nothing is lost, and every engagement crosses the finish line. The AI Governance Concierge Service is not simply an approval function — it is a service built around bringing every engagement to a successful conclusion. That means approving solutions that meet dentsu's standards, identifying alternative products or approaches that address the business need within governance requirements, and providing solutions that facilitate approval where possible. When risks are identified that prevent approval, the service's role is to clearly document and communicate those risks and leave the decision to the business to weigh the risk and reward. Success is a business team that always has a clear path forward — not just a ruling. **What You Will Do** **Submission Intake \& Program Management** * Receive and thoroughly review each submission package approved by the Service Lead — developing a deep understanding of the business case, vendor research, risk profile, and policy rationale before the review process begins. * Project\-manage each submission through the full review lifecycle in AIRS and TPSA — tracking every open item, deadline, and reviewer action from submission to final determination. * Set and communicate the review schedule for each submission based on priorities identified and communicated by the Lead; maintain that schedule actively throughout the review and implementation phases. * Update the AI Concierge Program Tracker with accurate, real\-time progress during the review and implementation phases, ensuring the Service Lead always has a current view across all active engagements. * Work closely with the Analyst when reviewers require additional research, documentation, or clarification — coordinating the request clearly, reviewing what comes back for completeness, and routing it to the appropriate reviewing function without delay. * Report status, progress, and blockers to the Service Lead on a regular cadence, enabling the Lead to keep the business team accurately informed at all times. **Cross\-Functional Review \& Relationships** * Build and maintain trusted working relationships with counterparts in Legal, Information Security, Data Privacy, Emerging Technology, and Procurement — positioning the Concierge Service as an organized, reliable partner that makes their review process easier, not harder. * Shepherd each submission through the full cross\-functional review process — serving as the knowledgeable, primary point of contact for all reviewing functions, engaging each group with the context and detail they need to review confidently. * Partner with Global Enterprise Technology to shepherd each request through the review process, ensure Global Enterprise Technology's requirements are met at the engagement level, and coordinate the technical backend of implementation. * Translate technical and legal concerns from reviewers back to the Service Lead and Analyst in plain language — enabling accurate communication to the business team and ensuring the Analyst has what they need to produce any required follow\-up documentation. **Escalation \& Risk Management** * Identify blockers within the governance or review process and surface them to the Service Lead immediately with clear context and recommended resolution paths. * Own the follow\-through on blockers — actively working to resolve open items, maintaining momentum on stalled submissions, and not waiting for issues to resolve themselves. * Escalate risk\-flagged items to the Service Lead and relevant stakeholders; document disposition rationale for all escalated items. **Implementation \& Delivery** * Upon approval, own and coordinate the full implementation of each approved solution — working w n, and clear communication. * Clear, precise communicator — able to translate between technical, legal, and business audiences without losing accuracy in either direction. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a media, marketing, advertising, or professional services organization. * Familiarity with GenAI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO 42001\) or data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA). * Hands\-on experience with enterprise AI platforms (Claude Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, or similar) and their enterprise deployment requirements. * Background in vendor risk assessment, third\-party due diligence, or enterprise technology procurement. * Experience with Coupa, ServiceNow, OneTrust, or similar enterprise workflow and compliance platforms. * IAPP AIGP, CIPP, CISSP, PMP, or equivalent certification is a plus. **What Success Looks Like** In your first 90 days, you have taken ownership of the active submission queue, established working relationships with your counterparts in Legal, Privacy, Security, Emerging Technology, Procurement, and Global Enterprise Technology, and can speak confidently to the details of every submission in your queue. You have a clear, documented view of where every open engagement stands and what is needed to move each one forward. At six months, the average time\-to\-approval has measurably decreased. No submission goes dark — every open item has an owner, a deadline, and a next action. Reviewing functions know who you are and trust that you come prepared. You have completed at least one end\-to\-end implementation, and the Analyst rarely needs to be pulled back into a submission once it has entered your review queue. At one year, the Governance Engineer function is recognized across the review community as a reliable, organized partner. The implementation pipeline is clean, the CSDM is accurate, and the post\-launch review process is a standard part of every engagement. Your process improvements have meaningfully reduced the manual effort required to move a submission from intake to closure. The annual salary range for this position is $82,500 \- $130,000\. jobs.description: The purpose of this role is to develop best in class strategies and management of all Insights and Analysis activity on assigned clients, to manage and develop the team and serve as a point of escalation as needed.**Job Description:** Merkle's Commerce Analytics \& Intelligence practice helps the world's largest retailers, brands, and marketplaces turn data into decisions across the four Ps — product, price, promotion, and place — and against the competitive market. We are moving from an embedded, staff\-augmentation delivery model to a craft\-led consultancy: named specialists organized by discipline, US\-onshore leadership in front of a global delivery engine, and value measured by the decisions we enable rather than the hours we bill. The Director, Commerce Analytics is a US\-based onshore craft leader accountable for one of our largest enterprise accounts. You pair fluent business acumen with a strong technical foundation — AI and machine learning, Python, SQL, and cloud computation — and you use both to own the analytics craft end to end: consumer decision modeling, pricing and promotion, assortment and space, and competitive intelligence. You lead a blended onshore/offshore pod, sit at the client's table as a trusted advisor, and translate business need into a delivery plan the offshore engine executes. This is a build role: you are shaping how the practice operates as much as running the work. **What you will own** * **Client partnership.**Be the senior analytics voice the client relies on — present the standard rather than wait for the ask, bring proposals not order\-taking, and hold the relationship at the business\-decision altitude, not the report altitude. * **The craft.**Own the analytics discipline across the account: consumer decision modeling and the semantic/decisioning layer, pricing and promotion, assortment and localization, digital shelf and competitive intelligence — the me\-vs\-market view of the four Ps. * **A blended pod.**Lead a flat, project\-based team drawn from a single global Merkle pool — onshore practitioners in front, offshore engineering and data\-science engines behind. Assemble teams around projects, not titles; project leadership follows the work. * **Delivery you can prove.**Stand up and run a value cadence: weekly delivery status with dated milestones, risks and dependencies; monthly project\-based business readouts per area; and a scorecard that shows the client what their investment returns — baselines stated honestly, targets met. * **Documentation and governance.**Ensure solutions live visibly in the client's environment with current documentation, clear workflows, and a governance standard any party can pick up — closing the gap between what the team delivers and what the client can see. * **Growth.**Convert delivered value into expansion — new decisions, new areas, new scope — and feed the account's forward pipeline in partnership with account and client\-success leadership. **What you will bring** * **Fluent business acumen.**You read a P\&L and a merchant's world with equal ease — you can move between the four Ps and the levers behind them (traffic, transaction, units, conversion, margin), translate a business question into an analytical answer and back, and hold your own in a boardroom, not just a data review. * **Strong technical background.**Deep, hands\-credible expertise across the modern analytics and AI stack — AI and machine learning, Python, SQL, and cloud computation (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure and their data/ML services) — plus fluency in the market\-leading tooling of the moment: LLMs and agentic/GenAI, semantic and decisioning layers, experimentation and attribution platforms, and modern BI. You do not have to be the builder on every project, but you must be credible enough to architect, challenge, and lead engineers and data scientists. * **8\+ years in commerce, retail, or merchandising analytics,**with real functional depth in at least two of: pricing and promotion, assortment and space, consumer decision modeling / CDT, or competitive and digital\-shelf intelligence. You have sat on the merchant or business side of these decisions, not just the reporting side. * **Consulting and client leadership.**You have led senior client relationships as a trusted advisor, set the analytical standard, and navigated a large, matrixed client organization — comfortable proposing the path rather than executing a spec. * **Onshore/offshore delivery leadership.**You have led blended teams across time zones and shores, translated business intent into a technical plan, and held delivery quality and dates without a heavy management layer beneath you. * **A build\-and\-shepherd temperament.**You set standards, raise risks early, escalate rather than absorb, and grow people by the work they lead — not by title. **What sets the strongest candidates apart** * Direct experience inside a big\-box or enterprise retailer's merchandising, category management, pricing, or online organization. * Experience standing up a decisioning or semantic\-layer product, business decision engines — taking it from concept to a governed, enterprise\-wide capability. * A track record of converting a delivery relationship into a strategic, consultative partnership — and growing it. **How this role fits** This Director sits within Merkle's DBT\-aligned Commerce Analytics practice, reporting into practice leadership, with account P\&L owned above the role. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Systems
jobs.description: Job description Company and benefits Social Impact \& Sustainability Job ID 41663 **About Us** Dolby Cloud Solutions is a video streaming software company that helps enterprise and mid\-market organizations deliver exceptional audio and video experiences to their audiences. The Dolby OptiView SaaS platform serves a growing portfolio of customers across media, advertising, and real\-time communications — with a mission to make immersive video experiences accessible and scalable for everyone. **About This Role** Dolby Cloud Solutions is embedding AI into the core of how it operates — not as a side project, but as a fundamental shift in how work gets done across the business. The philosophy guiding this work is simple: AI prepares, humans decide. This is a Staff\-level engineering role at the center of that effort. You will own the technical architecture of the shared AI infrastructure that DCS teams build their business processes on — and you will build specific solutions on top of it. You will define the patterns, standards, and integration approaches that others follow, and serve as the technical authority when architectural decisions need to be made. Business problems are owned by business stakeholders. You will work closely with those stakeholders — helping shape requirements and acceptance criteria where needed, then owning the build end to end. You will also collaborate with OptiView Product Engineering on shared infrastructure and systems integration, and engage Product Engineering when platform features or APIs need to be developed to support the work. **What You'll Do** **Own the AI systems architecture** * Define the technical architecture of the shared data and integration layer — not just build it, but set the standards and patterns that others build on top of * Establish integration patterns, credential management standards, and data access models that scale across teams and systems * Ensure the infrastructure is secure, observable, and operable — not just functional at launch **Build and integrate across systems** * Architect and implement the foundational data and integration layer that enables AI agents and applications to operate reliably across business functions * Build and maintain integrations between business systems — CRM, billing, support, product usage, and more — so that data flows where it needs to go * Collaborate with Product Engineering on shared infrastructure, systems integration, and platform capabilities — you know when to build and when to align * Configure and manage MCP servers and API connections to internal systems, with proper credential management and security controls * Stand up shared hosting infrastructure for agents, automations, and applications, moving work off local workstations and into production environments * Build scheduled automations and event\-driven workflows that run reliably without manual intervention **Deliver business solutions** * Work with business stakeholders to understand problems, refine requirements, and define acceptance criteria — then own the build * Develop customer\-facing and internal applications from requirements and user stories — these may be web applications, headless services, agentic flows, or a combination * Build AI\-powered workflows for business teams including customer health monitoring, automated alerts, meeting intelligence, and revenue lifecycle automation * Iterate rapidly: deploy working software, collect feedback, and improve **Raise the technical floor across DCS** * Set the technical bar for how AI systems are built, integrated, and maintained across the organization — your decisions become the standard others follow * Maintain a shared repository of prompts, agents, skills, and workflows organized for reuse across teams * Help colleagues across Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Finance build and deploy their own AI solutions on the shared infrastructure **What You Bring** **Required** * 5\+ years building production software — applications, APIs, backend services, platform infrastructure, or data integrations — with a demonstrated track record of leveraging AI\-assisted development tools (Devin, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as a core part of engineering delivery * Proven experience making architectural decisions, set technical standards, and influenced how an engineering organization builds * Strong with Python or TypeScript/Node.js; comfortable picking up whatever the job requires * Experience building tool\-use integrations for AI systems; familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar protocols/frameworks is strongly preferred * Proven experience integrating with SaaS APIs (REST, webhooks, OAuth) — you have connected real business systems and understand the edge cases * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic frameworks — you have built production agents or AI\-powered workflows, not just prototypes * Comfortable working with business stakeholders — you can participate in requirements discussions, ask the right questions, push back constructively, and translate business intent into working software * Experienced collaborating with product and platform engineering teams — you know how to articulate what you need, align on approach, and get things built across team boundaries * Security\-conscious: you understand data classification, access controls, API credentials, compliance requirements, and risk management principles, and you incorporate them into the systems you build **Strong Plus** * Experience designing federated data layers, shared integration infrastructure, or multi\-system data pipelines * Familiarity with common SaaS business systems used in revenue, support, or customer success operations * Background in Customer Success, RevOps, or SaaS B2B — you understand the business domain you're building for * Experience incorporating data classification, compliance, security, and risk assessment considerations into the design and operation of AI\-powered systems and business automations

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Storage - Distributed Caching
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ The Storage organization builds and operates the online stateful systems and abstractions that DoorDash Engineering depends on: reliable, efficient, secure, and easy to use. Within Storage, the Distributed Caching team owns every caching offering at DoorDash end to end, including ElastiCache (Redis/Valkey), Boulder (our KVRocks\-based key\-value store for high\-QPS feature serving), Entity Cache (read Bill Shen's engineering blog post, "High\-Performance Proxy Cache for DoorDash Services"), and the Distributed Lock Service, plus the smart clients (asgard\-redis, valkey\-go) that sit in front of them. These systems back critical product surfaces across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo: the team runs roughly 400 ElastiCache clusters serving hundreds of millions of GET requests per second in aggregate, and Boulder, our offline\-to\-online feature store, serves billions of feature lookups per second at peak. **About the Role** ------------------ The team owns provisioning of clusters and the smart clients that sit in front of them, baking in sensible defaults so that other engineering teams get a turnkey caching solution instead of having to run their own. You'll help drive Boulder's evolution to scale further, improve cost efficiency, enhance performance, and support real\-time updates; re\-platform the Distributed Lock Service onto a strongly consistent backend; and build the self\-serve tooling and recommendation engine that let customers describe a workload (QPS, TTL, payload size, latency profile) and get the right backend without talking to a human. You'll go deep on cache invalidation, replication, sharding, compaction, and failover, while shipping the guardrails, automation, and observability that keep this scale operable by a small team. You must be located in San Francisco, Seattle, or the New York Metro Area for this hybrid position. You will report to the Engineering Manager on the Distributed Caching team within the Storage organization. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Own high\-leverage caching and locking services with direct, measurable customer impact: cost, latency, and reliability at multi million QPS scale. * Build and scale Boulder, our KVRocks backed key\-value store, including compaction, sharding, and domain isolation. * Re\-platform the Distributed Lock Service onto a strongly consistent backend with sharding * Contribute to the standardized smart caching client that bakes in failover, retry, and observability defaults so customers don't have to think about them. * Diagnose and resolve production issues that span cache invalidation storms, replication lag, hot shards, and noisy\-neighbor contention, then turn each one into a durable guardrail rather than a one\-off fix. * Collaborate closely with the teams that build on top of caching, including Taulu, ML Platform, and product engineering across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. **We're excited about you because…** logging, tracing, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and service\-health instrumentation. * Drive continuous improvement across CI/CD, observability, deployment practices, Infrastructure as Code, automation, testing, incident response, capacity management, resilience, and operational readiness. * Identify recurring or systemic production issues and translate operational experience into improvements in code, architecture, automation, tooling, and engineering practices. * Partner with Software Engineering teams to incorporate reliability, resiliency, scalability, performance, observability, recoverability, and operational readiness throughout the development lifecycle. * Participate in or lead incident response, troubleshooting, service restoration, and blameless automation, reusable patterns, and better engineering practices. **Leveling Intent** Principal represents domain\-level technical leadership and organizational impact. jobs.title: Staff Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: This role is based in Palo Alto, California, and follows a hybrid work model. If you’re excited about helping build a large\-scale SaaS platform at an early\-stage company and the qualifications below align with your background, we’d love to connect! **About Us** ------------ Endor Labs is building the Application Security platform for the software development revolution. Modern software is complex and dependency\-rich, making it increasingly difficult to pinpoint the risks that truly matter. Endor Labs solves this challenge by building a call graph of your entire software estate—enabling teams to clearly identify, prioritize, and fix critical risks faster. Trusted by companies that are one or one hundred years old, Endor Labs secures code whether it was written by humans or AI, and whether it's 40\-year old C\+\+ code or cutting edge Bazel Monorepos. Endor Labs was founded by serial entrepreneurs Varun Badhwar and Dimitri Stiliadis, and is backed by leading VC firms such as Dell Technology Capital, Lightspeed, and Sierra Ventures. Sound interesting? Let’s talk if you want to be part of the next big leap in security innovation! **How You'll Make an Impact** ----------------------------- * **Join Our Cutting\-Edge Backend Team:** Dive into the heart of innovation by working on a state\-of\-the\-art distributed system with a sophisticated monorepo architecture. * **Own Core Product Functionality:** Own the core functionality at the heart of Endor’s AppSec platform. Design and deliver features that secure source code end to end, from IDE to deployment, fueling the next generation of AI\-driven software development. * **AI Code security \-** Be at the forefront of securing customer code with bleeding edge AI code security solutions. * **Elevate Core Services**: Drive the development and optimization of vital core services like our API Gateway and API servers, ensuring robust and scalable infrastructure. * **Maintain diverse scan environments** \- Enhance our dynamic cloud scan platform by supporting the ever\-growing build and tool chain requirements. * **Innovate with Autonomy**: Embrace the freedom to design and build top\-tier tools that will be leveraged across all teams at Endor, making a significant impact on our operations. * **Champion Observability**: Apply best practices in observability to ensure our products and platforms achieve exceptional reliability and availability for our users. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **Engineering Expertise**: Bachelor’s in engineering and 8\+ years of experience. * **Golang Mastery**: Showcase proven experience in Golang programming, with a deep focus on microservices and distributed architecture, to drive our cutting\-edge solutions. * **Build tools and tool chains familiarity \-** How different tool chains like Maven, pip, npm work to provide a seamless scan experience for our customers. * **Scalable Systems**: Bring your experience with scalable distributed systems, including microservices, domain\-driven design, load balancing, and scaling strategies (both horizontal and vertical), to tackle complex challenges. * **Effective Communicator**: Leverage your ability to discuss architectural trade\-offs and guide teams towards the most effective solutions, ensuring alignment and forward momentum. * **Adaptable Innovator**: Thrive in a fast\-paced environment with shifting requirements, embracing change and finding creative solutions to new and unfamiliar problems. * **AI Savvy \-** Leverage AI and automated code generation tools to accelerate the delivery of robust, security\-hardened, and production\-grade software. **Preferred Skills** * **Master of Secure Design**: Expertise in secure software design principles, including managing certificates, OAuth2/OIDC, and implementing secure changes. * **Cloud\-Native Proficiency**: Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Lambda functions, or other cutting\-edge cloud\-native technologies. * **Security Savvy**: Knowledge of security, fraud prevention, and anomaly detection to tackle real\-world challenges and safeguard our systems with cutting\-edge solutions. **Why Endor Labs** ------------------ We’re building at the intersection of developer productivity and security — one of the fastest\-growing spaces in software. Our dev\-loved platform has real ROI, strong momentum, and customers who care about doing things right. At Endor Labs, we think big, start small, and learn fast. We take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with the customer’s success. We debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. We celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way — because when our customers win, we all win. **Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one\-size\-fits\-all here. **Compensation** For candidates who receive an offer for this position, the compensation range is expected to be between $200,000 \- $250,000\. clarity, accuracy, and ongoing updates. * Stay current on emerging engineering and AI\-assisted development practices and share effective techniques with the team. **What You Bring** **Required** * jobs.title: Head of Growth Marketing

You will own how engineering leaders in aerospace, defense, automotive, and adjacent industries discover Flow, and you will turn that awareness into qualified pipeline. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own pipeline: set demand generation targets alongside sales and leadership, then build and run the programs to hit them. * Build a repeatable inbound motion across content, search, paid, email, and web, with honest attribution from first touch to closed won. * Run account\-based campaigns against a defined list of hardware engineering organizations, working shoulder to shoulder with founder\-led and early enterprise sales. * Develop messaging and positioning for a technical audience of systems engineers, program managers, and engineering executives, then test it until it lands. * Treat the website as a conversion surface: product pages, technical content, demo requests, and self\-serve entry points. * Own the events and field calendar, including industry conferences, customer roundtables, and webinars that reach buyers in regulated industries. * Stand up marketing operations and reporting so every program carries a cost per opportunity and a clear signal on what to cut or scale. * Partner with product and engineering on launches so new AI capabilities reach the market with a story customers actually understand. **About you** ------------- * 8\+ years in B2B marketing, including 2\+ years leading growth or demand generation, ideally taking a startup from early traction to repeatable pipeline. * Track record of owning a pipeline number and hitting it, with the reporting to show how you got there. * Experience marketing a technical product to a technical buyer. Exposure to hardware, aerospace, defense, automotive, or engineering software is a strong plus. * Comfortable with long, multi\-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and the content and nurture programs they require. * Strong writer who can turn complex engineering workflows into clear, credible copy without overclaiming. * Analytical and self\-sufficient with funnel data, experiment design, and attribution. * Comfortable in a high\-ownership, fast\-paced environment where you scope your own work and ship it. **How we work \& values** ------------------------- * Speed over everything: get campaigns live quickly, then harden and scale what works. * Own, downscope, ship, iterate: one clear owner per program, from first idea to measured result. * Fundamentals done well: measurement, attribution, and reporting are part of the first version, not an afterthought. * Competitive salary and meaningful equity. * Health, dental, and vision coverage. * Flexible time off and support for experimentation, learning, and staying current with the AI ecosystem. jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer

executive\-level communication. **What will you be doing?** --------------------------- * Partner with Account Executives on strategic opportunities, owning the technical strategy required to navigate and close complex enterprise deals. * Lead technical discovery to understand customer objectives, architecture, workflows, integrations, security requirements, and technical constraints. * Translate complex requirements into thoughtful solutions using Front’s AI capabilities, APIs, integrations, automation, and broader platform. * Design and deliver tailored product demonstrations that connect Front’s capabilities to customer use cases and measurable business outcomes. * Position Front’s AI\-powered customer service capabilities with technical and executive audiences, clearly communicating value, considerations, and limitations. * Architect and lead hands\-on AI proofs of concept and technical evaluations, defining success criteria and validating performance, feasibility, and business impact. * Serve as the technical lead for pilots and evaluations, managing technical dependencies, troubleshooting challenges, and ensuring successful outcomes. * Develop deep expertise in Front’s APIs and extensibility platform to design creative integrations with customers’ existing systems and applications. * Build credibility with Engineering, IT, Security, Operations, and Architecture teams while effectively communicating technical concepts and business value to C\-level executives. * Partner with Product and Engineering to bring customer insights into product discussions and influence Front’s roadmap. * Identify reusable technical patterns, demonstrations, and best practices that improve the effectiveness of the broader Solutions and Sales organizations. * Act as a senior technical voice in the field, raising the technical bar and mentoring other team members when appropriate. **What skills \& experience do you need?** ------------------------------------------ * **7\+ years of experience** in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a similar customer\-facing technical role, ideally within enterprise SaaS. * Proven success partnering with sales teams to navigate and win complex enterprise opportunities. * Strong experience designing and demonstrating solutions involving **AI, automation, and complex business workflows**, AI quality, performance, and impact. * Strong understanding of modern AI concepts and the ability to clearly explain their capabilities, tradeoffs, and limitations to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong technical foundation in **APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows, integrations, and modern SaaS architectures**. * Experience working with REST APIs and independently prototyping or troubleshooting integrations. jobs.title: Assistant Professor, Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description:** The School of Engineering and Computing at Fairfield University invites applications for a tenure\-track faculty position at the assistant professor rank in the Michael Zabinski Department of Mechanical Engineering. The start date for this position is September 1st, 2027, pending budget approval. Candidates in all areas of Mechanical Engineering or closely related fields are encouraged to apply. Position Description: This position requires an ability to perform teaching, scholarship, and service responsibilities. The successful candidate will be required to: (1\) develop and teach undergraduate and graduate courses (lecture and laboratory) in mechanical engineering. (2\) supervise Master theses, undergraduate research, capstone projects, and senior design projects; (3\) pursue scholarly activities (including externally\-funded research and peer\-reviewed publications); (4\) engage in academic advising and mentoring; and (5\) assist in program assessment, execution of the department’s continuous improvement plan, and documentation in support of ABET accreditation. The position is an academic (9\-month), tenure\-track appointment, and the salaries are competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience. The School of Engineering and Computing is organized into the Michael Zabinski Department of Mechanical Engineering, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, and the Department of Electrical, Mechatronics, and Biomedical Engineering. The Mechanical Engineering program is ABET accredited and offers Bachelor of Science and Master of Science degrees. In addition, students have an option to obtain a Concentration in either Automation, Robotics, and Manufacturing or Aerospace Engineering. The department is equipped with state\-of\-the\-art laboratories such as Material Characterization Lab, Automation, Robotics and Manufacturing (A.R.M.) Lab, Mechanical Engineering Lab, and the High\-Speed Fluids Research Lab. It also houses the Brinkman Manufacturing Laboratory and the Innovation Annex in support of teaching and research and boasts the highest undergraduate enrollment within the School of Engineering. Required Qualifications: * A Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering or closely related discipline. * Effective verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to effectively teach both undergraduate and graduate courses, including hands\-on labs. * Demonstrated potential to engage in funded research in a relevant field, along with a demonstrable publication record. Preferred Qualifications: Candidates with expertise in experimental and applied areas of Mechanical Engineering are encouraged to apply. Computational expertise is considered a favorable additional qualification when complemented by hands\-on, applied research and teaching experience. Areas of interest may include, but are not limited to, solid mechanics/structures, thermal\-fluid sciences, energy, aerospace, and other emerging areas of Mechanical Engineering. Screening of applications will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. Full consideration will be given to candidates who apply by November 1st, 2026\. The preferred starting date is September 1st, 2027\. Please combine and upload the following materials in **a single PDF document**. A complete application will consist of: (1\) a cover letter addressing the qualifications (one\-page), (2\) a statement of teaching interests and research plan (two pages), (3\) a curriculum vitae, and (4\) the names and contact information of three professional references (references will not be contacted without prior knowledge and approval of candidates). Applicants are encouraged to submit a project portfolio (three to five pages with annotated photographs or a link to a website repository) that illustrates hands\-on, project\-based contributions. Only complete electronic applications will be considered. Inquiries about the position should be addressed to the Chair of the Search Committee, Dr. David Shekhtman (engineeringsearch@fairfield.edu). For more information on Fairfield University, please visit www.fairfield.edu. For more information on the School of Engineering and Computing, please visit www.fairfield.edu/sec. **Category:** Academic \- Faculty Tenure/Tenure Track Performs such other duties, responsibilities, and activities as required by supervisor and as departmental/University needs indicate. * Disclaimer The above information indicates the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain and should not be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, activities, and/or qualifications required or expected of employees assigned to this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change and new ones may be assigned at any time, with or without notice. *All offers of employment are contingent upon a satisfactory background check.* Fairfield University provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Unified Experience
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **About the Role** Support Fanatics Collect's Unified Experience initiative, building seamless collector journeys across Fanatics Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, Topps, and future experiences. Today a collector can win a card in a live show, rip a pack, buy on the marketplace, and store it all in a vault — but those moments still feel like separate products. Your job is to make them feel like one. That means building the shared surfaces, APIs, and front\-end systems that connect experiences that were each built independently, and doing it without slowing any of them down. This is a hands\-on senior role. You'll own meaningful slices of the unified experience end to end — schema to API to UI — and you'll do it alongside a Staff Backend Engineer, mobile engineers, product, and design. **Why Join Us** Fanatics Collect is growing fast, and the unification work is the highest\-leverage engineering investment we have: every new app, drop, and live format gets easier once the shared foundation exists. You'll work across mobile, web, and internal tools, with real autonomy and a short path from idea to production. Your teammates are passionate about the space and most of them are collectors themselves. **Product Context and Scale** Our surfaces reach millions of collectors across iOS, Android, and web, with live, high\-traffic moments (breaks, drops, auctions closing) that make performance and reliability non\-negotiable. You'll be working in a landscape of multiple existing products with real users and real data, so migration, backward compatibility, and careful rollout are part of the craft. **First 90 Days** * Ship a meaningful, user\-facing piece of the unified experience end to end. * Build a working map of how Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, and Topps actually fit together today — data models, identity, entitlements, and the seams between them. * Establish working relationships with the backend, mobile, product, and design partners you'll depend on. * Identify one piece of duplicated or divergent logic across surfaces and make the case for consolidating it. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain fullstack features using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and TypeScript. * Build scalable, performant, highly available services and interfaces on AWS and Vercel. * Own features end to end: data model, API contract, front\-end implementation, tests, rollout, and post\-launch metrics. * Build and maintain reusable front\-end components, APIs, and shared libraries that multiple apps (web and mobile) depend on — and treat other engineers as first\-class consumers of what you build. * Contribute to cross\-surface concerns like shared identity, entitlements, inventory, and navigation between collector experiences. * Ship behind feature flags with instrumentation in place, and use the resulting data to decide what to keep, fix, or cut. * Prototype quickly with Product and Design when a working demo will settle a debate faster than a document. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, LLM\-backed workflows) to raise your own throughput, and share what works with the team. * Write meaningful tests across the stack — unit, integration, and E2E — using Playwright, Jest, React Testing Library, and Pytest, and keep CI/CD pipelines trustworthy. * Maintain component documentation and interaction specs via Storybook. * Participate in sprint planning, retros, and product strategy sessions; raise scope and sequencing concerns early rather than at the end. * Mentor engineers through code review and pairing, and raise the bar on code structure, testing, and documentation. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of professional fullstack development experience, with demonstrated proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Python, plus hands\-on cloud experience (AWS preferred). * Strong grasp of architectural patterns, API design, and application performance tuning — and the judgment to know when a simpler solution is the right one. * Track record of owning features end to end in production, including the parts after launch: monitoring, debugging, and iterating on real user behavior. * Solid front\-end fundamentals: jobs.title: Senior IT & Corporate Engineering
jobs.description: Flex is building the **AI\-native private bank for business owners**. We’re re\-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. **Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.** Since launching publicly in **September 2023**, Flex has scaled from **zero to nine\-figure annualized revenue**, with a clear path to **profitability by late 2026**. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are **affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)**—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a **\~$1T\+ revenue market** hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a **$100B\+ company** by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M\+ in equity and $300M\+ in debt.* **Mission\-critical problems**: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. * **High bar, low ego**: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. * **Speed over comfort**: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. * **Enduring impact**: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. **Team \& Locations** We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. **Flex Fuels Ambition.** ### **About The Role** This role owns IT and corporate engineering at Flex, end to end. It reports directly to the CTO. We think IT's job is enablement. The measure of this function is not how many tickets it closes or how many controls it can point at. It is whether everyone else at Flex can do their work faster and more safely than they could last quarter. A new hire productive on day one instead of day four. An engineer who gets exactly the access they need in minutes, without asking twice and without being handed the keys to everything. A team that can adopt a new tool because someone reviewed it properly, not because they routed around IT to buy it on a personal card. So we are not looking for a gatekeeper, or for someone whose default answer is no. The right person makes the safe path the easy path, and removes friction permanently instead of absorbing it repeatedly. Which is why this role also owns Flex's corporate security posture. Identity, access, endpoints, and the SaaS estate are one system, and the person who makes access fast should be the person who decides how much access is reasonable. Split those across two teams and employees route around both. You'll set conditional access and MFA policy, own privileged access and endpoint posture, and run third\-party OAuth and Workspace grant review. Our security engineers own the product and infrastructure side, the money paths and the code, and you'll work with them constantly. Corporate security is yours to decide, not to implement on someone else's behalf. This is the hard part of the job, and we'd rather say so than leave it as a bonus line. The argument between moving fast and holding a line is now an argument you have with yourself. Day to day, what gets tightened, what gets mitigated, and what we knowingly accept is your call; the large ones come to the CTO, and we'd rather see a close call early than find out you decided it quietly. What we'd ask is that a no comes from a real read of the risk and the business context rather than a standard applied by default. The rest of the work has two halves. The IT half is the fleet, identity, access, the SaaS estate, and the joiner/mover/leaver process, delivered with help from a managed IT partner who handles procurement, device logistics, tier\-1 support, and international coverage. You own that relationship, define the SLA, and enforce it. The corporate engineering half is the part we think makes this a good job: writing the automation and internal tooling that means the IT half doesn't scale linearly with headcount. If a process only works because a person runs it by hand every Tuesday, we'd rather you replaced it. You'd be inheriting an estate here, not starting one. The first year is as much untangling what has already accumulated \- stale access, tools nobody reviewed, processes that work because someone remembers them \- as it is building what comes next. Automate that assessment. Nobody should be reading through a SaaS estate by hand in 2026\. Now the shape of this. Flex is around 150 people, and you would be the only person in this function, with vendor capacity underneath you and a direct line to the CTO. That means real autonomy and real scope from week one. It also means this bing it. * You know you can't be in the loop on every request, and you don't want to be. You build the self\-service paths that let people get what they need without going through you. * You can hold a vendor accountable without turning the relationship adversarial. * You can tell a colleague, including a senior one, that what they've built can't keep the access it has, explain why in plain language, and work alongside them to find a way that works. * You're calm when something is broken and several people are watching. * You explain technical constraints clearly to people who don't share your background, in writing, across time zones. ### **What We're Looking For** * Substantial hands\-on experience owning IT or corporate engineering at a growing company, including a stretch where you were the most senior person doing the work. Roughly \[6\+] years is typical, but we care about what you've owned, not the year count. * Deep, hands\-on ownership of an identity provider (Okta, Entra, JumpCloud, or similar) at the design layer: SSO, SCIM, SAML, group and entitlement modeling. Not just the admin console. * Practical experience running Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 as a platform. * Real MDM and endpoint experience across macOS, and ideally Windows, in a remote or hybrid company. * Automation ability in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar), and comfort with APIs and identity plumbing. * Experience designing an access model and running access reviews, not only fulfilling requests. * Real ownership of identity security decisions, not only their execution. You've set MFA or conditional access policy, tightened privileged access, or cleaned up third\-party app grants, and you can talk about what you traded away to do it. * Track record managing an outsourced IT provider or MSP, or a clear\-eyed view of why the ones you've worked with succeeded or failed. * Clear written communication. Much of this job is asynchronous and cross\-team. ### **Strongly Preferred** * Experience in a regulated or audited environment (SOC 2, PCI, or a bank partnership), as the control owner rather than the auditor. * Time as the senior security voice somewhere without a security team, or without a CISO to escalate to. * Experience supporting employees and contractors across multiple countries, including device logistics and local employment platforms. * Experience at a company that grew quickly enough that you had to replace your own early processes. * Experience introducing AI tooling internally in a way that was actually adopted and actually governed. ### **Interested? We'd love to hear from you** At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don't fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success. Join us at jobs@flex.one Flex is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital or family status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we'll sort it out. **Why Join Us** **Build something generational** — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.**Work on real money, real risk** — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.**Solve hard problems** — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.**True ownership** — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.**Founder\-level exposure** — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.**High bar, high taste** — Move fast without cutting corners.**Elite peers** — People here are builders, not tourists.**Real upside** — Meaningful equity if you help build something big. Flexbase Technologies Inc.

jobs.title: VP of Global Sourcing, Power and Systems
jobs.description: Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com . **Job Description:** **Role Summary** The Vice President, Power and Systems leads Fluence's global direct materials strategy and execution across the power conversion, electrical systems, systems integration, and balance of plant portfolios. The role carries approximately $1\.2B in annual spend today. As Fluence converts contracted backlog and pipeline into deployed capacity, that portfolio is expected to exceed $5B in annual spend within three years. Scaling the function to carry that volume is the central mandate of this role. The supplier base, commercial structure, organization design, and cost discipline required at $5B differ materially from what supports the business today. This leader builds that capability while continuing to run the portfolio, without compromising cost performance, supply continuity, or quality through the ramp. Scale is not the objective on its own. Growing volume is leverage, and this role is accountable for converting it into significant year over year cost reduction and measurable gross margin improvement. Unit costs are expected to come down as volume goes up. Every incremental gigawatt is expected to strengthen Fluence's commercial position with its supply base. A leader who administers a larger portfolio at today's cost structure will not succeed here. This is a builder role rather than a caretaker role. It calls for a senior leader who is equally credible leading an enterprise cost review with the CFO and the CPO and reviewing a should cost teardown on a power conversion system at a supplier facility. Fluence is seeking an ambitious supply chain executive who wants a highly visible platform, accepts the demands of a multiyear scaling effort, and expects to be measured on results. The role reports directly to the Chief Procurement Officer and is a proving ground for the next level of executive leadership at Fluence. **Scope and Organization** This role consolidates the full non battery direct materials portfolio under a single leader, organized into two category towers led by Directors. * **Director, Power Conversion \& Electrical Systems.** Power conversion systems, inverters, transformers, UPS, and electrical and electronic controls. Also owns the Advanced Procurement function covering new product introduction, early supplier involvement, and design for cost. * **Director, Systems Integration \& Balance of Plant.** Enclosures, contract manufacturing, thermal management including HVAC, chillers and plumbing, fire detection and suppression, and system monitoring, software, and controls hardware. Also owns the Claims and Contracts function covering claims management, back charge recovery, contract administration, and dispute resolution. Beneath the two Directors sit Category Managers and Specialists across multiple regions. The Vice President owns the growth and design of that organization as spend scales. The Vice President sets portfolio strategy, cost targets, and supplier architecture, and leads the largest and most strategic negotiations. The Directors own category level execution, day to day supplier management, and delivery against committed targets. The Vice President is the escalation point on commercial disputes, capacity constraints, and cross tower tradeoffs. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Organizational Design and Scale** * Design and build the direct materials organization required to carry the portfolio from its current level to more than $5B in annual spend. Own org design, job architecture, headcount planning, and the build, buy, or develop decision for each seat. * Establish the operating rhythm that makes scale possible: governance cadences, category strategy reviews, quarterly business reviews, cost reviews, and a single reporting standard across both towers. * Set category level KPIs and one source of truth on commercial contracts, quality, delivery, innovation, sustainability, and risk. Report a consolidated view to executive leadership. * Build process and systems capability that scales faster than headcount, so that growth in spend does not require proportional growth in team size. **2\. Category Strategy and Supplier Architecture** * Own and evolve the multiyear category strategy across the full portfolio, including commodity segmentation, make or buy decisions, and regional supply balance. * Architect a globally diversified and regionalized supplier base that is resilient to geopolitical exposure and single source risk, and that holds the physical capacity to support Fluence  ith CFO, CPO, and executive leadership. Board level reporting exposure preferred. * Working knowledge of regulatory, tax, and government manufacturing incentive compliance, traceability requirements, and domestic content rules relevant to energy storage supply chains. * Bachelor degree required in engineering, supply chain, or business. MBA or advanced technical degree preferred. **Leadership Profile** * A builder and an operator, equally credible presenting a business case to the executive team and standing on a supplier shop floor. Has progressed through doing and delivering rather than advising. * Ambitious and clear about it. Understands that scaling a portfolio of this size is how a leader earns the next seat, and wants that outcome. * Prepared for the demands of a multiyear scaling effort and motivated by the difficulty rather than deterred by it. * Treats scale as leverage. Sees every increase in volume as an opening to reset commercial terms, not as a reason to accept higher cost. * A systems level thinker with the discipline to go deep personally on the two or three issues that matter most in any given quarter. * A multiplier who builds team capability faster than the business adds headcount, rather than becoming the constraint. * Comfortable being measured on hard numbers, including COGS impact, PPV, OTIF, and supply continuity, rather than narrative or cost avoidance. * Executive presence that holds upward with the Board, the executive team, customers, and suppliers, and downward with Directors, Category Managers, and Engineers, without losing credibility in either direction. **Location and Travel** * Based in Houston, Texas, with an expectation of 3 to 4 days per week in the office. * Travel of 25 to 35 percent, domestic and international. **Our Culture** At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world. **Unleash Voices** We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress. **Customer Fluent** Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate. **Infinite Impact** We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game\-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy\-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come. **All In** We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success. *Equal Opportunity Employer* *At Fluence, we believe great teams are built on a collaborative and connected culture. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome qualified applicants of all backgrounds. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other status protected by law.* *Work Authorization* *To join our team, you’ll need to be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout your employment, without the need for employer sponsorship. Please note that Fluence does not sponsor work visas for this position.*

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **\\u007C About us:** Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition\-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs. Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer\-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money. Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost\-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low\-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet\-related diseases. At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment: Customer First \- You start with the member and work backwards. Make It Happen \- You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards. One Team \- You collaborate with respect and commit as a group. Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food. ### **\\u007C About the role:** Foodsmart is seeking a Staff AI Engineer who will play a critical leadership role in shaping the architecture and delivery of AI\-powered systems across the organization. You’ll operate at the intersection of backend engineering and applied machine learning—designing resilient infrastructure, deploying cutting\-edge models, and mentoring engineers across teams. This role goes beyond building software: it’s about setting strategy, elevating engineering standards, and turning AI innovation into scalable, real\-world impact. ### **You will** * Own the architecture and implementation of distributed, high\-scale backend systems and APIs that serve machine learning models in production. * Lead technical design for AI integration across product lines, enabling real\-time and batch inference workflows using LLMs, transformers, and classification models. * Drive the fine\-tuning and deployment of pre\-trained models (e.g., from Hugging Face or OpenAI) for mission\-critical business use cases in domains such as healthcare, finance, or operations. * Integrate external AI services where appropriate and evaluate trade\-offs for build vs. buy decisions. * Define and evolve platform\-wide standards for backend engineering, MLOps, model governance, and observability. * Mentor and support senior and mid\-level engineers, both within your team and across functions, to elevate system design and code quality. * Collaborate with cross\-functional leaders in product, ML research, data engineering, and DevOps to align technical initiatives with business goals. * Influence AI strategy and roadmap, evaluating emerging technologies and frameworks for future adoption. * Lead root\-cause analyses and performance tuning to ensure systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. ### **You are** * A senior technical leader with a demonstrated ability to architect, build, and scale AI\-backed systems in production environments. * Comfortable operating across layers—from backend API services to AI Services and ML model lifecycle management—while driving architectural clarity and system\-level thinking. * Experienced in bridging the gap between research and production, with a strong focus on reliability, maintainability, and business outcomes. * Skilled at leading cross\-team initiatives, guiding technical direction, and fostering a high\-trust engineering culture. * Able to influence without authority, collaborating across teams to align on complex technical trade\-offs. * Deeply invested in engineering excellence, with a strong bias toward automation, observability, and security. ### **You have** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2\+ years at the Staff Engineer level or equivalent * 4\+ years of experience with backend development in TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL\-based RDBMS (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) * 1\+ years deploying ML/AI models to production, with hands\-on experience fine\-tuning LLMs or transformer\-based models * Deep understanding of system architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and scalable API design * Strong experience with Data Pipeline tooling (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, dbt, Dagster) and model deployment practices * Proven leadership in setting technical direction, mentoring engineers, and driving cross\-team projects to completion * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field Role: Staff AI Engineer Location: United States (Remote) Base Salary Range: $190,000\-$210,000 Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by work location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. ### **\\u007C About our benefits and perks:** ✅ Remote\-First Company ✅ Unlimited PTO ✅ Flexible \& remote location ✅ Healthcare Coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision) ✅ 401k \& bonus ✅ Registered Dietitian Sessions Foodsmart is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

microcontrollers and embedded software * Experience with vehicle or embedded communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, Automotive Ethernet, or similar networked systems. * Proven ability to develop traceable electrical hardware and system level requirements from high\-level features to implementation specifications * Advanced vehicle architecture or experience with EV prototype development, jobs.description: **About the role** We are seeking a high\-impact, technically deep Machine Learning Engineer to develop, optimize, and deploy production ML models across our autonomous vehicle (AV) stack. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building models end\-to\-end \- from data and training through optimization and real\-time deployment on autonomous vehicles. prototypes to validate where agentic workflows can fully own or materially reshape engineering tasks, including autonomous MR authoring, test creation and triage, security remediation, release readiness, and incident response * Design and implement reference architectures for agentic SDLC inside GitLab, including orchestration patterns, safety guardrails, observability, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls * Define evaluation frameworks using offline benchmarks and online experiments to measure correctness, latency, safety, cost, and productivity impact of agentic workflows and link agentic interventions to real business outcomes * Capture and codify reusable patterns, libraries, and playbooks that other teams can adopt with minimal friction * Work with Product compliance, and data governance requirements across GitLab.com and self\-managed customers * Serve as a point of escalation for complex technical and architectural decisions related to agentic workflows, AI safety, and large\-scale systems integration * Mentor Principal and Staff Engineers working on AI and agentic efforts, raising the overall bar for technical execution, experimentation rigor, and cross\-team collaboration * Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that help teams make aligned, high\-quality decisions independently * Represent GitLab in the broader ecos uage models, agentic frameworks, and autonomous workflow design at production scale * Proven track record of leading hands\-on technical experimentation, including defining evaluation frameworks, running benchmarks, and translating findings into scalable architecture decisions * Strong background in scalable, multi\-tenant distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience * Experience designing and implementing human\-in\-the\-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for production systems * Demonstrated ability to drive cross\-functional alignment across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Data and ML teams on complex, ambiguous technical challenges * Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams or divisions without direct authority * Ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization with excellent written and asynchronous communication skills * Familiarity with GitLab's DevSecOps platform, CI/CD primitives, and the software development lifecycle is a strong plus *The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only.
