jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description: Overview: **THE ROLE** At Great Dane, we rely on makers and we’re calling on them to join our expanding team, the time has never been better to Embrace Your Great and work in an environment with the highest safety standards in the industry. The Position: The Data Architect designs and governs the enterprise data architecture underpinning Great Dane's Durable Hub — the company's central data and integration hub — and leads the IT Data Engineering team that builds and operates it. This role owns the canonical data model, pipeline topology, and integration patterns that move data from source systems (JDE E1, Salesforce, Tacton CPQ, Concept, PLM, and other SaaS solutions) into the medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture. The Data Architect partners with the Enterprise Architect, the Data Governance Committee, and Data engineering teams to ensure data is modeled once, governed centrally, and consumed reliably across analytics and operational use cases. The Data Architect also ensures Great Dane's enterprise data architecture is optimized for AI, machine learning, agentic workflows, and decision intelligence — designing data products, semantic models, the enterprise ontology, metadata structures, lineage, and knowledge representations that enable reliable consumption by analytics, predictive models, large language models (LLMs), and intelligent automation solutions. Responsibilities: **WHAT YOU’LL DO*** Lead and manage the IT Data Engineering team, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and workload prioritization, guiding engineers on state management, topic design, and data contract patterns. * Own and evolve the Canonical Data Model (CDM) and enterprise object model — including the enterprise ontology that gives AI systems a shared, machine\-interpretable definition of core business entities and their relationships — ensuring a single governed definition across the enterprise. * Design end\-to\-end data pipeline topology for the central data and integration hub, including ingestion lanes (CDC, API polling, order\-saga orchestration), stream processing (Kafka/Flink), and the Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion layers. * Define integration patterns and specifications for source systems including JDE BSSV operations, Salesforce, and Tacton CPQ. * Establish and maintain data modeling standards, event schemas, and immutability/replay ability principles to ensure data consistency, integrity, and reliability across analytics and operational systems * Design and govern data architecture patterns that support advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic automation use cases. * Define enterprise semantic models, the enterprise ontology, metadata standards, business glossaries, and knowledge representations that provide consistent context and interpretation for analytics, AI assistants, and intelligent agents. * Establish standards for reusable data products that can be consumed by reporting, predictive models, digital assistants, and operational automation workflows. * Partner with the AI Architect and Data Governance Committee to define lineage, explainability, auditability, privacy, and trust requirements for data used by AI solutions. * Define architecture patterns and governance standards for structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data assets to support analytics, digital thread initiatives, and AI\-enabled knowledge discovery. * Partner with the Data Governance Committee to translate governance policy into enforceable technical architecture. * Maintain architectural decision logs, marking superseded decisions rather than deleting them, and document final records to SharePoint and diagrams to Miro. * Other duties as assigned. Qualifications: **YOUR SKILLS \& ABILITIES (REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS)** * Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field; Master's preferred. * Experience: 7\+ years in data architecture, data engineering, or a related discipline, including hands\-on design of enterprise data platforms and canonical/dimensional data models, and prior experience leading or managing a technical team. Demonstrated experience with streaming/event\-driven architectures (Kafka/Confluent), lakehouse/medallion patterns, and integration with ERP and CRM systems. * Skills: Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop a data engineering team. + Deep proficiency in data modeling, SQL, and stream processing (Flink or equivalent); familiarity with dbt, Iceberg, and cloud data platforms (AWS). AWS certification a plus. + Modern Data Architecture: Experience designing data products, semantic layers, and enterprise metadata architectures. + AI Data Foundations: Understanding of data architectures supporting machine learning, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), vector search, ontologies (including the CDM) and knowledge graphs, and AI\-enabled business applications. + Data Governance \& Trust: Knowledge of data lineage, data quality, ability to explain, and governance requirements for AI systems. + Strong grasp of data governance concepts and canonical modeling. Excellent written communication and stakeholder\-facing documentation. * Travel: Occasional; typically less than 10%. **PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:*** Office and plant environment. * Keyboarding, lifting, standing, bending, walking. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **ABOUT GREAT DANE** With a history dating back to 1900, Great Dane has established itself as a transportation solutions leader of today – delivering innovative products and exceptional services that help our customers and employees succeed. We not only engineer durable and high\-quality trailers and truck bodies; we foster relationships that last a lifetime. **WHY WORK FOR US?** Great Dane is a leading manufacturer of dry\-freight vans, refrigerated trailers, and flatbeds with 10 manufacturing facilities and 20 service centers throughout the United States. With a legacy like ours comes a dedication to the hard\-working individuals that make Great Dane what it is today. Our jobs are waiting to be filled by driven, challenge\-focused \& enthusiastic people like you. Our culture is comprised of “Champions” and offers a rewarding workplace rooted in core values of safety, leadership, integrity, quality, and passion. Every employee has opportunities to learn, grow, succeed and be engaged in a collaborative environment. **BENEFITS OVERVIEW*** Competitive compensation * Benefits, including but not limited to dental, vision, and medical with employer contributions * Retirement programs, including a Pension Plan and 401(k) Plan with employer match * Tuition Reimbursement * Paid holidays and vacation * And more! ***Great Dane is an Equal Opportunity Employer***

jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT GREENBOARD** At Greenboard, we're building the future of financial compliance. Greenboard is the unified, AI\-native compliance operating system for RIAs, fintechs, private funds, hedge funds, and more. It replaces the fragmented mix of legacy tools and automates more than previously possible. By centralizing data and workflows, Greenboard helps firms reduce regulatory risk, simplify their technology stack, modernize how they run compliance, and save money. Our founding team includes engineers who have scaled products at Amazon, Google, and multiple unicorn startups. We're backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Base10, and other top\-tier investors, and have raised over $20M to date. Brand\-name financial institutions already rely on Greenboard, and we're growing fast. **ABOUT THE ROLE** You'll be our first dedicated Automation engineer. Our customers are regulated financial institutions, which means a missed bug is not just a bad user experience. It can mean an incomplete books\-and\-records archive, a marketing review that never routed for approval, or an attestation that quietly failed to send. Quality is part of the product we sell. You'll own how we test: the framework, the automated suites, and the release process, built from scratch and then embedded with the engineers who ship. You'll also help us solve something most automation engineers have never had to solve, which is how to test AI systems whose output is not deterministic. There is no existing playbook here. If you like defining the standard rather than enforcing someone else's, this is the seat. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** * **The foundation.** Test framework, automated regression suites, and QA practices built from zero, with your call on tooling * **The critical paths.** Message archiving and supervision, marketing review routing, employee attestations, and audit trails, which are the flows that cannot break * **Testing the AI.** How we evaluate AI\-driven detection and review, including golden datasets and quality bars for output that is not deterministic * **Data integrity at scale.** End\-to\-end validation from ingestion of tens of millions of messages a day through to what a compliance officer sees on screen * **The release gate.** Bug triage, release sign\-off, and the definition of deployment\-ready at Greenboard **WHO ARE YOU?** * Love to move fast and build things * Looking for deep ownership over the quality of everything we ship * Obsess over the customers you're building for * An excellent communicator * Value collaboration * Located in NYC **QUALIFICATIONS** * 3\+ years testing software where being wrong has consequences beyond a bad review: fintech, healthtech, payments, or anywhere an audit followed a bug * Able to test a system you cannot fully see from the UI. Comfortable with REST APIs and querying the database directly, because verifying a feature here means checking what landed and what the retention policy did with it, not just what rendered * Write Playwright or Cypress suites that survive a redesign, with opinions about selectors, fixtures, and what belongs in an integration test versus an end\-to\-end one * Can read a feature spec and name the states nobody thought about: the employee who left mid\-attestation, the message that arrives out of order, the marketing piece edited after approval * Have held a release before, explained why to someone who wanted it out, and been right **NICE TO HAVE** * Tested a system where output is not deterministic and had to define correct as a threshold rather than an exact match * Worked in a Node JS and React codebase on AWS, or debugged a queue\-based ingestion pipeline * Been through a SOC 2 audit and know what evidence a test suite can produce for one * Sat with a compliance officer, an advisor, or a back\-office team and watched them work * Interest in the financial industry is a plus, but not necessary **BENEFITS** * 401(k) with 5% company match * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * 15 days PTO \+ 11 company holidays \+ flexible sick time * 2 additional PTO days for each year of service (up to 10 additional days) * 10 remote days per year plus additional around the holidays * Bi\-annual off\-sites and team retreats * Front\-row seat to building the operating backbone of modern finance Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Data & Analytics
jobs.description: **About Us** Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care. We deliver high\-touch, relationship\-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care. We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations. Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors. **About The Role** We're hiring our first dedicated data person. This person will build on our existing data platform, harden it to ensure consistent performance and build upon our metric library to ensure that our operators can monitor performance across all of our levers. Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and visualization in dashboarding tools As Data and Analytics Engineer, you own four things: * **The analytics layer**: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them * **Reporting and BI**: the reporting layer the whole business reads from * **Our production systems**: you take ownership of systems as they come in\-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime \& system integrity * **The partnership with our engineering team**: you are the internal counterpart who knows both the business and the systems well enough to resolve most issues directly This is a build\-and\-own role. Our engineering partner stands up a new capability; you take it on once it is live, harden it, and keep improving it. You work as their peer rather than their coordinator. You also partner closely with the pop health team (who owns our value drivers) in defining metrics and deciding together what the business needs to see. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health. **Location:** New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates. **What You'll Do** Own the Analytics Layer * Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic our metrics and workflows depend on. Work within Google Cloud to iterate on our business logic and transformation infrastructure * Ensure consistency in definitions across all surfaces at Greenbrook * Work with the performance managers on what needs measuring and what good looks like in their areas Take Ownership of What's in Production * Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep them healthy * Be accountable for uptime \& system integrity – catch ingestion and pipeline issues or logic bugs and resolve them within our SLAs. Develop monitoring and uptime reporting. * Ensure a performant system. Optimize workloads and runtime * Keep improving what you take on rather than only maintaining it Partner Across the Business * Be the counterpart our engineering partner can hand production work to, resolving what you can and escalating what needs them * Build dashboards to support organizational decisionmaking * Work closely with the business – sit in the operating meetings where the data gets used, so you know what decisions it feeds **What Success Looks Like** * Data Trust: the business trusts the numbers, and you are ahead of issues rather than behind them * Reliability: systems transitioned to you stay healthy, and when they break they get fixed quickly * Coverage: the metrics our drivers depend on have a certified definition and a single source of truth * Delivery: the work you committed to for the quarter shipped * Metrics you'll own: delivery against committed quarterly work, and counterpart satisfaction among the performance managers and the Head of Population Health **About You** You bring: * Fluency in dbt and Python * Hands on experience with Health care datasets and interoperability frameworks which our business run on, including a deep understanding of claims, eligibility, EHR data, and frameworks such as FHIR and HL7 * A solid grasp of business fundamentals, enough to partner with business and clinical managers on defining metrics rather than only building to spec * Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks * Bachelor's degree required * A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork You'll stand out if you: * **Want to own a system deeply**: you would rather take something into production, harden it, and keep improving it than move on to the next greenfield build * **Get to root cause**: you find out why a number is wrong rather than patching the symptom * **Are AI\-native**: you live in modern AI tools to support your work * **Communicate with clarity**: you are comfortable explaining complex data to business users and communicate proactively * **Own the outcome**: high bias for action, follow through on commitments, and close loops without needing to be chased **Why You'll Love Working Here** **Make An Impact Every Day** Be part of a mission\-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare. **Work That Actually Matters** We're not a volume\-driven system, we're accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered. **Build And Grow With Us** We're building more than a company, we're building careers. As we expand, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges. **Strong, Transparent Compensation \& Benefits** * $170,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications * Generous annual performance bonus * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off * 401(k) with company match **Our Selection Process** Application Initial interview Skills/experience interview Values interview Case Study and Case Study Interview References **Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity** At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We do this through a culture of respect and belonging, ensuring our teammates feel cared for first and foremost. We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

We are committed to innovation, safety, quality, and reliable products that support critical energy infrastructure. * Position Overview Join HD Hyundai Power Transformers USA as a Mechanical Engineer and help develop the mechanical design of large power transformers from customer requirements through manufacturing release. This role works closely with electrical and control design, project engineering, purchasing, quality, suppliers, and manufacturing to deliver safe, reliable, manufacturable, and cost\-effective designs. * Key Responsibilities * Develop 2D/3D mechanical layouts, models, customer drawings, and manufacturing drawings using AutoCAD, Siemens NX, or equivalent CAD tools. * Design transformer tanks, covers, stiffeners, conservators, radiators/coolers, piping, platforms, brackets, lifting lugs, jacking pads, pulling eyes, and related mechanical components. * Verify internal/external clearances, interfaces, foundation requirements, shipping configurations, manufacturability, and site/transport constraints. * Perform or support mechanical calculations for pressure/vacuum, structural strength, lifting/jacking, transportation, seismic and wind loading; use FEA when required. * Prepare and maintain BOMs, material specifications, drawings, calculations, and project documentation. * Interpret customer specifications and applicable IEEE/ANSI/IEC requirements and incorporate them into practical mechanical designs. * Coordinate with engineering, quality, purchasing, suppliers, and manufacturing to resolve technical and manufacturability issues. * Provide engineering support to fabrication, assembly, testing, field service, and production, including root\-cause investigation and corrective actions. * Support standardization, design\-for\-manufacturing, cost reduction, and on\-time completion of assigned engineering deliverables. * Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering field. * Minimum 3 years of mechanical design experience in power transformer manufacturing or comparable heavy electrical/mechanical equipment. * Proficiency in 2D/3D CAD software such as AutoCAD and Siemens NX, Creo, Inventor, or similar. * Working knowledge of fabricated steel structures, welded assemblies, pressure/vacuum loading, lifting, transportation, and manufacturing processes. * Ability to perform engineering calculations and interpret analysis results; familiarity with ANSYS, Nastran, or similar FEA tools. * Ability to interpret technical specifications, drawings, standards, and manufacturing requirements. * Strong written and verbal English communication skills and ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities. * Preferred Qualifications * Experience with medium/large power transformers, autotransformers, generator step\-up transformers, or similar high\-voltage equipment. * Knowledge of IEEE C57 / ANSI and IEC 60076 transformer requirements. * Experience with transformer tank/external design, cooling arrangements, transport/shipping design, seismic/wind requirements, or production issue resolution. * Familiarity with SAP or another ERP/BOM system. * Compensation \& Benefits * Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications. * Annual performance\-based bonus. * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance. * Company\-sponsored retirement savings plan and paid time off. * Relocation support and visa sponsorship may be available for eligible candidates. * Professional development opportunities in a growing power\-transformer organization. * Equal Employment Opportunity \& Applicant Privacy Statement (EEO) HD Hyundai Power Transformers USA, Inc. is committed to equal employment opportunity for all qualified individuals. jobs.title: Principal Software Architect
jobs.description: Principal Software Architect **Description \-** HP is seeking a **Principal Software Architect** to define and guide the architecture of modern software platforms within HP’s device and services ecosystem. This role will provide technical leadership across client applications, backend services, cloud integrations, device interfaces, enterprise workflows, AI\-enabled capabilities, and production\-scale software systems. In this role, you will help shape an incubation effort within HP’s PC ecosystem experience. You will work directly with customers to understand real\-world needs, incorporate feedback into product and technical direction, and architect new edge AI\-enabled experiences that have the potential to define the next generation of intelligent PCs and peripherals. The ideal candidate is a highly accomplished, hands\-on software leader with a demonstrated track record of architecting, building, and successfully shipping production\-grade AI/ML\-enabled products. Relevant experience may span several of the following areas: * Large language models, generative AI, and agentic systems * Speech, audio, and conversational AI * Computer vision and multimodal AI * Edge AI, local inference, and model optimization * Cloud\-native and distributed AI platforms * Embedded systems and device\-integrated software * Robotics, autonomous systems, or intelligent device control This individual will combine deep system\-level expertise with hands\-on technical credibility and the ability to translate ambiguous product, customer, and business requirements into practical architecture strategies and executable implementation roadmaps The architect must be able to communicate effectively with engineering teams and executive audiences, develop compelling technical and product narratives, build organizational support for new ideas, and advocate for the products and platforms they help create. This role requires strong system\-level thinking, hands\-on technical credibility, and the ability to translate ambiguous business, product, and engineering requirements into practical architecture strategies and implementation roadmaps. You will partner closely with software engineering, UX, product management, hardware engineering, security, manageability, validation, DevOps, systems engineering, and executive stakeholders to deliver high\-quality software platforms that support long\-term product evolution, operational reliability, and differentiated customer experiences. **Key Responsibilities** * Define and own the end\-to\-end architecture for complex, AI\-enabled software platforms spanning client applications, backend services, cloud workflows, local device interactions, connected hardware, and enterprise integrations. * Establish the architectural principles, system boundaries, design patterns, and technology choices required to deliver scalable, secure, reliable, maintainable, high\-performance, and extensible platforms. * Lead the architecture of AI/ML capabilities, including generative AI experiences, LLM and agentic workflows, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, model orchestration, inference services, traditional machine learning, and edge AI execution. * Design production\-ready AI/ML systems with robust approaches for evaluation, experimentation, model and prompt versioning, telemetry, monitoring, feedback loops, responsible AI, safety controls, and operational governance. * Align architecture across local applications, cloud services, enterprise identity, device management platforms, connected devices, firmware\-adjacent interfaces, and backend systems. * Define and address critical non\-functional requirements, including security, privacy, compliance, performance, resiliency, auditability, manageability, diagnostics, deployment readiness, and supportability. * Maintain strong hands\-on technical engagement through prototyping, architecture and code reviews, technical investigations, performance analysis, and resolution of high\-impact engineering challenges. * Guide senior engineers and technical leads, raising standards for architecture, code quality, testing, design documentation, technical decision\-making, and software lifecycle practices. * Produce and maintain clear architecture artifacts, including system diagrams, architecture decision records, integration specifications, technical roadmaps, risk assessments, and platform evolution plans. * Evaluate emerging technologies, AI/ML frameworks, cloud services, and enterprise platforms, recommending adoption based on customer value, technical fit, risk, and long\-term viability. * Influence executive and cross\-functional stakeholders by clearly communicating technical strategy, architectural trade\-offs, risks, dependencies, technical debt, and recommended investment priorities **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree/ PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering. * 10\+ years of software e ncluding model integration, inference, optimization, and production deployment. * Understanding of edge AI considerations, **including model compression, quantization, hardware acceleration, latency, memory and compute constraints** , and hybrid edge\-cloud execution * Strong understanding of distributed systems, API design, service\-oriented and event\-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, messaging, caching, fault tolerance, and application state management. * Experience with AI service integration, LLM APIs, prompt workflows, model orchestration, embeddings, inference APIs, evaluation pipelines, and responsible AI development practices. * Experience integrating local software with cloud services, backend systems, enterprise identity providers, device management platforms, and enterprise software ecosystems. * Strong understanding of software security, privacy, authentication, authorization, compliance, audit logging, data protection, and enterprise governance requirements. * Experience with Git\-based development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, release engineering, and production support practices. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Tauri, WebView, WebRTC, COM interfaces, PowerShell automation, native application integration, or cross\-platform desktop application frameworks. * Experience with Microsoft Graph, Microsoft Intune, Azure services, enterprise APIs, identity platforms, SSO, device management, or manageability workflows. * Experience with enterprise manageability solutions (MS Intune, ADMX/Group Policy, HP WXP or similar MDM/UEM platforms) * Experience with connected\-device software, peripheral integration, local device discovery, firmware\-adjacent workflows, or hardware/software co\-design. Experience building architecture for incubation products, proof\-of\-concept platforms, beta programs, early\-stage software initiatives, or new product introductions. * The pay range for this role is **$165,450** to **$259,750** USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). and modern versions up to .NET 10\. * Database Proficiency: 3\+ years of experience writing complex SQL queries, designing database schemas, and working with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle and bridging database interactions using LINQ. * Version Control: Proficient with version control systems (such as Git), including collaborative branching and merging strategies for managing source code. * AgileSDLC: 2\+ years of experience working within an Agile software development environment, participating in sprint rituals (standups, planning, retrospectives) and translating user stories into technical specifications. * Data Formats: Proficient with standard web data interchange and integration formats, including JSON and XML. * Web Hosting: Experience working with Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS v10\) and Windows Server (2016, 2019, 2022\) operating environments. * Analytical Capabilities: Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging capabilities to isolate and resolve complex software defects and system performance bottlenecks. * Communication Skills: Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear technical documentation and coordinate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Expertise** * Azure Cloud Technologies: Experience implementing applications in Microsoft building interactive web interfaces using Blazor (particularly Blazor Server/WebAssembly) and UI component suites such as Syncfusion Blazor, Syncfusion XlsIO, or Telerik UI (for ASP.NET Core, Blazor, or jQuery). * Test Automation: Experience with automated browser\-based testing frameworks, specifically implementing, converting, or running integration/smoke test suites in Playwright (replacing legacy Selenium tests). * DevOpsCI/CD Pipelines: Familiarity with configuring, documenting, or maintaining automated CI/CD build and deployment pipelines and branch management strategies in Microsoft Azure DevOps (ADO). * Federal Systems Support: Prior experience supporting federal IT projects, specifically for the Department of Transportation (DOT) or the FHWA Office of Policy, with familiarity in reporting systems (e.g., TMAS, HPMS, PIDP, ITIP). * Enterprise Reporting Tools: Experience developing structured and analytical reports using Telerik Reporting. * Professional Certifications: jobs.title: Director, Forward-Deployed AI Solutions
jobs.description: **ROLE OVERVIEW** As a forward\-deployed AI operator within Real\-World Data Solutions (RWDS), you will work at the intersection of people, process, data, and technology to turn messy operational challenges into AI\-enabled systems that perform in daily work. You will embed directly with the teams doing the work: observing how workflows actually operate, identifying the right intervention, building the smallest useful solution, testing it with real users, and improving it until it delivers measurable value. Sometimes that solution will use AI; sometimes deterministic automation, an existing platform, or a process redesign will be the better answer. Your job is to make that judgment and own the outcome. This is a senior, hands\-on builder role for an operations\-minded problem solver—not a traditional software engineering position. You should be comfortable building with modern AI, automation, analytics, and low\-code tools, while partnering with data and engineering teams when a solution requires production\-grade infrastructure. Because this role sits at the center of how RWDS delivers for clients, the work you do here should show up in two core ways: how clients experience working with us, and how profitably we operate **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Discover and document how work actually happens: the people, approvals, exceptions, and informal tools (spreadsheets, Slack threads, workarounds) that fill the gaps in official process * Build and ship AI\-enabled tools, workflows, and automations directly with the analysts and teams who'll use them * Own your tools past the demo stage — make sure the underlying data logic is sound and the tool holds up as usage scales, partnering with engineering to productionize and incorporate into enterprise tooling * Use current AI/LLM tooling (agents, RAG, coding assistants) to build faster, and know when a lightweight tool or application is the right call versus when it needs to be a real engineered solution * Design appropriate human review, exception handling, monitoring, and governance into each solution from the beginning * Actively gather voice\-of\-client feedback from analysts and business stakeholders to determine what should be built * Pilot new tools with a small group of real users before scaling team\-wide, and use that feedback to shape the broader rollout * Communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders * Take ownership of a defined portion of the AI/tooling roadmap for RWDS with minimal oversight — you're expected to drive, not just execute against someone else's plan * Train the RWDS and dependent teams on AI tooling and maintain ongoing communication to support adoption **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required** * Ability to understand data structures, trace data through a workflow, validate business logic, and collaborate effectively with analysts and engineers * Track record of driving a project or initiative from ambiguous problem to shipped solution with real adoption, without needing heavy oversight * Demonstrated experience with LLM\-based tools and practical AI integration patterns * Understanding of responsible AI and data governance in a regulated industry * Able to recognize when a lightweight solution is appropriate—and when security, scale, data complexity, or reliability requires engineering partnership * Strong communication skills — able to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders and turn a vague business ask into a scoped technical plan **Preferred** * Analytics/data engineering, or ETL background, or equivalent depth working directly with large relational databases (SQL, Python, Databricks, or equivalent) * Experience building playbooks, training programs, or enablement materials that scaled technology adoption across a team * Some prior leadership or informal mentorship experience — this role is expected to grow into more ownership over time * Experience evaluating or piloting new AI platforms and tools, and making a real build\-vs\-buy call rather than just experimenting * Exposure to complex analytics workflows leveraging large data environments * Familiarity with real\-world healthcare data (claims, EHR, labs, registries, or similar patient\-level datasets) and how it's used in life sciences work We welcome portfolios, capstone projects, workflow maps, automation examples, or case studies that demonstrate how you diagnosed a problem, chose an approach, built and deployed a solution, earned user adoption, and measured the result. We care more about demonstrated judgment and shipped outcomes than whether your previous title included "AI." Base salary for the role is commensurate with experience and can range between $190,000 \- 240,000 \+ annual bonus opportunity. ### **Hiring Locations** Our main office is located in Center City, Philadelphia, where we operate on a hybrid model with in\-office work required three days a week for local employees. We believe collaboration is most effective when pported in the following key hub locations and approved states: **Hub Locations:** * Philadelphia, Pennsylvania * Boston, Massachusetts * New York City, New York * Baltimore, Maryland * Washington, D.C. * Charlotte, North Carolina * Raleigh\-Durham, North Carolina * Atlanta, Georgia * Chicago, Illinois **Approved States for Remote Work:** CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TN, and VA. **About HealthVerity** HealthVerity is the leader in privacy\-protected real\-world data exchange, transforming how healthcare and life sciences organizations connect and analyze disparate patient data. By enabling access to the industry's largest RWD ecosystem, HealthVerity supports critical applications in clinical development, commercial strategy, regulatory decision\-making, and public health. To learn more about HealthVerity, visit healthverity.com. **Why you'll love working here** **We are making a difference** – Our technology is at the forefront of some of the biggest healthcare challenges in the world. **We are one team** – Our people define our culture and always will. We take time out to celebrate each other, and acknowledge the value that each of us adds towards our greater mission. Come share all you have to offer. **We are learners** – Every team member is continually learning, no matter if we've been in a role for one year or much longer. We are committed to learning and implementing what is best for our clients, partners, and each other. **Benefits \& Perks** Our benefits package is thoughtfully designed to support and enrich the experience of our full\-time employees, with eligibility limited to those in permanent positions. * **Compensation:** competitive base salary \& annual bonus opportunity (for non\-commissioned roles) * **Benefits:** We offer health, dental, and vision coverage starting on day 1\. We also offer a 401(k) plan and an equity program, with new hire equity grants beginning at the Director level and above. * **Flexible location:** Remote workdays and 3 days a week of in\-office collaboration for team members in the Philadelphia area. Check location requirements with the recruiting team. * **Generous PTO:** Take time off as needed, targeted at 4 weeks per year, including vacation, personal and sick time, plus paid parental leave. * **Parental Leave:** 12 weeks paid leave for childbearing, surrogacy, and adoption; 6 weeks for non\-childbearing parents. * **Comprehensive and individualized onboarding:** mentorship program, departmental talks, and a library of resources are available beginning day 1 for each new team member to minimize the stress of starting a new job * **Professional development:** biweekly 1:1s, hands\-on leadership that is goal\-and growth\-oriented for each team member, and an annual budget to support professional development pursuits We believe incorporating different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds make us stronger and encourages an environment where ageism, racism, sexism, ableism, homophobia, transphobia or any other form of discrimination are not tolerated. All qualified job applicants will be given consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. At HealthVerity, we're working towards an innovative and connected future for healthcare data and believe the future is better together. We can only do that if everyone has a seat at the table. If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to careers@healthverity.com Remote opportunities are not available in all areas and require team members to work from a fixed location due to tax and labor law implications \- specific questions about remote positions can be discussed during the interview process with your recruiter.

jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.description: **Love building new things—but also get a weird amount of satisfaction from tracking down the one plugin, line of code or integration causing everything to misbehave? Hiebing is looking for a curious and resourceful Web Developer who’s excited to build smart digital experiences, solve unfamiliar problems and keep growing alongside a collaborative team. WordPress will be at the center of the role, but your work—and your opportunity to make an impact—will extend well beyond it.** Hiebing is seeking a curious, motivated and innovative Web Developer who is eager to build intelligent solutions in a fast\-paced, collaborative team environment. Our team values learning, support and innovation, creating a culture where developers can grow, contribute and have fun doing great work. WordPress development and maintenance will be at the center of this role, but we’re looking for someone who is equally energized by troubleshooting an integration, helping implement tagging, debugging an email or figuring out something they haven’t encountered before. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter who is curious, resourceful and motivated to find answers independently. They see unfamiliar challenges as opportunities to learn rather than barriers and are comfortable moving between different types of digital work as client and team needs evolve. This role will initially be divided between new WordPress development and maintenance for existing clients, with the potential to create new capabilities and offerings for our clients and eventually lead the WordPress development practice at Hiebing. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop, enhance and maintain WordPress websites, including block editor/Gutenberg development, theme customization, plugin configuration and integrations. * Troubleshoot and resolve website issues, including plugin conflicts, third\-party integrations, browser and device inconsistencies, and performance problems. * Support ongoing website maintenance, landing pages, forms, content migrations and other digital enhancements across multiple client properties. * Assist with analytics and tagging implementations using tools such as Google Tag Manager and GA4, including implementation, troubleshooting and QA. * Support email development and production needs, including building and modifying HTML emails, troubleshooting rendering or template issues, and conducting technical QA. * Implement and troubleshoot marketing technology integrations, including forms, analytics, consent management, email platforms and other third\-party tools. * Work within Git\-based development workflows and follow established practices for commits, branching, pull requests, releases and documentation. * Collaborate with developers, digital strategists, project managers, designers and other team members to solve problems and deliver high\-quality work. * Maintain security, accessibility, performance and quality standards across development work. **Required Skills and Experience** ---------------------------------- * 2–3 years of professional web development experience, with meaningful hands\-on WordPress theme development experience. * Comfort using GitHub Copilot for AI\-assisted development and as part of the problem\-solving process. * Strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript fundamentals. * Working knowledge of PHP and WordPress development. * Experience with WordPress themes, plugins, Gutenberg/block editor and common marketing\-site integrations. * Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills. * Experience working with Git\-based version control. * Ability and willingness to work across different types of technical assignments rather than specializing exclusively in one area. * Resourceful and comfortable researching unfamiliar problems and identifying solutions independently. * Self\-motivated, with the ability to take ownership of work and follow it through to completion. * Curious and eager to learn new technologies, platforms and approaches. * Familiarity with analytics, tagging and marketing integrations, including GA4/GTM, consent tools, A/B testing, email providers and CDPs. * Accessibility awareness, including WCAG fundamentals, and experience implementing accessible UI patterns. * Able to manage multiple priorities and shift between projects in a fast\-paced environment. * Collaborative, dependable and committed to producing high\-quality work. **Nice\-to\-Have Skills and Qualifications** -------------------------------------------- * WooCommerce or Shopify experience, including checkout optimization, payment and shipping plugins, and catalog organization. * Comfort with WP\-CLI, Composer, deployment automation and modern WordPress build pipelines. * Experience implementing WordPress hardening practices, including secure configuration, plugin governance and least\-privilege access. * Familiarity with unit testing or automated regression testing. * Hands\-on experience with Email on Acid or Litmus to create visual and brand consistency across email devices and clients. **You’ll Thrive Here If…** -------------------------- * You enjoy building new digital experiences—and making existing ones work better. * You see an unfamiliar technical problem as something to investigate, not something to avoid. * You’re willing to dig into documentation, test possible solutions and ask thoughtful questions when needed. * You can move comfortably between development, maintenance, troubleshooting, analytics, tagging and email work. * You take ownership of your work and care about seeing it through from initial request to final QA. * You balance speed with thoughtful attention to security, accessibility, performance and quality. * You’re curious about AI and emerging technology while still bringing your own judgment and problem\-solving skills to the work. * You believe the strongest solutions come from developers, strategists, designers and project managers working together. **Where You’ll Work** --------------------- This position is based in Hiebing’s Madison, Wisconsin office. Collaboration is an important part of how we work at Hiebing. This position follows our hybrid work model, which includes working from the Madison office each Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, with the option to work remotely Thursday and Friday. Candidates who do not currently live within commuting distance should be willing to relocate to the Madison area. **Why Hiebing?** ---------------- At Hiebing, you’ll work alongside smart, kind and incredibly talented people who genuinely enjoy making each other’s ideas better. You’ll collaborate across disciplines, support regional and national brands and have the opportunity to build digital experiences that matter—for our clients, their audiences and each other. We’re a place where curiosity is celebrated, craftsmanship is respected and thoughtful judgment is just as valuable as bold ideas. We believe in speaking in data, Dreaming in Color and never settling for the expected. You’ll be challenged to grow, encouraged to explore new technologies and supported by teammates who believe the best work is always built together. We’re insight\-driven ideamakers who give a damn—about the work, our clients and one another. Our We Before Me philosophy reminds us that the strongest work is never about one person; it’s about what we build together. If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, sharing what you learn and using technology to create smarter, more meaningful experiences, you’ll feel right at home here. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Hybrid work environment with the option to work remotely Thursday and Friday * Competitive medical, dental and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match and profit sharing * Paid parental leave * Generous paid time off, including your birthday off * Professional development funding and ongoing learning opportunities * Opportunities to give back through meaningful pro bono work and community involvement * Investment and partnership opportunities * Dog\-friendly office * A culture built around curiosity, collaboration and our We Before Me philosophy **Work Authorization** ---------------------- Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. jobs.description: Minnesota \- Other #### **Hollstadt Overview** Hollstadt Consulting is a management and technology consulting firm dedicated to placing professionals at engagements where they will excel. We're committed to treating you with respect and helping you achieve your career aspirations. Our continued growth has created challenging and rewarding opportunities for accomplished IT and Business Consultants. Hollstadt Consulting is an equal opportunity employer including disability/veteran. *By applying for this job, you agree to receive calls, AI\-generated calls, text messages, or emails from Hollstadt Consulting and its affiliates, and contracted partners. Frequency varies for text messages. Message and data rates may apply. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. You can reply STOP to cancel at any time.* **Job Description** **Role**: COBOL Developer **Contract**: 1 year **Location**: Remote **Pay Rate**: $65\-$75/hour W2 **Required Skills** * Progressive and recent experience in enterprise level software development and configuration using multiple tools and technologies that include COBOL and/or Micro Focus COBOL, SQL, GitHub, and Linux, as well as experience with job scheduling tools, XML, and SFTP file transfer. * Communication skills sufficient to understand business needs and functional requirements, to describe the value and proposed solutions to business owners in terms that they understand, and to create and maintain technical documentation. * Analytical skills sufficient to assess requirements, alternatives, risks, and make decisions that solve system level problems. * Relational database experience sufficient to design changes to the existing database and write complex queries and scripts. * Software testing skills sufficient to provide reasonable assurance that products meet business needs before promotion to the test environment. **Desired Skills** * Experience working independently and collaboratively within a geographically dispersed team. * Experience working in an Agile development environment with SCRUM processes. * Experience with code deployment processes. * Experience with the iPaaS integration tools such as Dell Boomi. * Experience with enterprise batch scheduling tools such as JAMS. * Experience configuring third party vendor products and writing custom APIs. **The Contractor will**: * Bring their own computer device and setup a local development environment with appropriate access and development tools. * Fetch COBOL source code out of source code control with appropriate access. * Identify and implement database changes required to meet business needs of the development requirements. * Identify logic changes required to meet business needs. This may include reading and interpreting government technical requirements. * Write code to implement needed new logic. * Compile and unit test code changes. * Promote code from development to test and from test to production. * Triage and fix any reported defects from unit and quality testing. * Create guides and diagrams to document completed work. * Engage in peer code reviews. * Provide knowledge transfer. ### **Benefits \+ Perks** Comprehensive Benefit Plan Hollstadt offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, paid sick leave, and retirement benefits to eligible employees. With three different medical plans to choose from, you can enroll in the coverage you need from individual to family, or anywhere in between! Remarketing Process Hollstadt is based on retention and relationships. We get to know your strengths and career wishes throughout your assignment and then start remarket discussions 6\-8 weeks prior to your end date. By being proactive, we are able to keep your down time between assignments as short as possible, unless you choose otherwise. Professional Development Hollstadt offers on\-demand training through our consultant portal. Trainings give our consultants the continuing education they need to excel on their projects. Many of our courses apply towards continuing education credits and we have an entire training hub dedicated to upskilling in Artificial Intelligence (AI). 401k \+ Matching One popular benefit is our 401(k) match on the first 4% of your contributions. Hollstadt wants to help you reach your long\-term financial goals and understands that planning for your future is critical. Consultants also have access to support from a Financial Advisor. Bonus Opportunities We appreciate and reward loyalty. Join Hollstadt, stay for 5 years, and we’ll give you a $5,000 Longevity Award bonus! Additionally, we know great talent knows other great talent. If you are on contract with Hollstadt and refer one of your connections who gets placed, we’ll pay you $1,000! Ongoing Support \& Networking We have made a significant investment in building a support program for our consultant team \- so you never have to feel like you are going it alone. We also have a Consultant Coach program which acts like a 'work buddy' to provide a safe ear for questions or concerns at your client site.

jobs.title: Lead Specialist – AI Scientist
jobs.description: Role Overview The AI Scientist will help define the technical direction for **AI model training, adaptation, and AI Agent development**, with a strong focus on transforming HR processes through intelligent AI solutions. This is a **hands\-on Scientist and Builder** role. The ideal candidate has experience training and adapting models—not simply consuming or calling existing AI models and APIs. Key Responsibilities * Define and drive the technical strategy for **AI model training, adaptation, and AI Agents** within the AgentOps team. * Design, build, train, fine\-tune, and evaluate AI/ML models. * Develop **AI Agents and intelligent automation solutions** for HR and enterprise use cases. * Support **digital transformation initiatives** through AI\-driven solutions. * Build scalable AI services and applications using **Python and modern web frameworks**. * Establish technical standards, architecture patterns, and best practices for AI development. * Evaluate new AI/ML technologies, models, frameworks, and agentic approaches. * Collaborate with HR, product, engineering, and technology teams to identify opportunities for AI transformation. * Translate AI research and emerging technologies into practical, production\-ready solutions. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship across AI/ML initiatives. * Drive innovation within the **AgentOps** organization and help shape Pearson's AI strategy. Preferred Technical Background **AI/ML:** Machine Learning • Generative AI • LLMs • AI Agents • Model Training • Fine\-Tuning • Model Adaptation • Model Evaluation **Programming \& Development:** Python • FastAPI • Flask • Django • REST APIs • AI/ML Application Development **AI Transformation:** Digital Transformation • Enterprise AI • HR AI • HR Automation • Intelligent Agents • Agentic AI **Leadership:** Technical Strategy • Architecture • Standards \& Best Practices • Technical Leadership • Cross\-functional Collaboratio **Ideal Candidate** The ideal candidate is a **hands\-on AI Scientist / AI Engineer / Applied Scientist** with 8–10 years of experience who can both **build AI systems and provide technical leadership**. The candidate should have demonstrated experience training or adapting models, building AI\-powered applications, and applying AI/Agentic technologies to real\-world enterprise problems. Experience in **HR AI Agents, digital transformation, Python, and Python web frameworks** is particularly valuable. **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * **8–10 years of experience** in AI/ML, Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering, or a closely related field. * Strong hands\-on experience **training, fine\-tuning, adapting, and evaluating AI/ML models**. * Strong **Python** programming experience. * Experience with **Python web frameworks** such as **FastAPI, Flask, or Django**. * Experience building and deploying **AI\-powered applications and services**. * Experience with **Generative AI, LLMs, and AI Agents**. * Experience designing or developing **AI Agents / Agentic AI solutions**. * Experience applying AI to **HR / Human Resources processes** or other enterprise business functions. * Strong understanding of **Digital Transformation** and using AI to automate and improve business processes. * Experience developing **HR AI Agents** or intelligent assistants for HR\-related use cases is highly desirable. * Strong technical leadership skills with the ability to establish **technical direction, standards, and best practices**. * Experience evaluating emerging AI technologies and translating them into scalable enterprise solutions. * Strong understanding of model evaluation, optimization, and performance improvement. * Ability to work closely with engineering, product, HR, and technology stakeholders.

jobs.title: Director, AI Engineering
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= We are seeking an accomplished Director of AI Engineering to lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of enterprise\-scale agentic AI capabilities within Humana's AI platform. This leader will drive the development of foundational AI services, frameworks, and platforms that enable the organization to rapidly build, deploy, and scale next\-generation AI solutions across diverse business domains. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in AI/ML engineering with proven leadership experience in building high\-performing engineering organizations. They will influence enterprise AI strategy, partner with senior technology leaders across architecture, security, data, and product teams, and establish the technical vision required to accelerate adoption of agentic AI while ensuring scalability, security, reliability, and business impact.**Key Responsibilities** **Team Leadership:** Lead and grow a team of AI engineers building foundational services, frameworks, and tools for agentic AI applications—enabling consistent, scalable, and cost\-effective development across the organization **Industry Expertise:** Stay current with industry trends in generative AI (e.g., foundation models, evaluation techniques, retrieval\-augmented generation, fine\-tuning approaches, and open\-source tooling) and help the team apply them effectively **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Drive cross\-functional alignment with enterprise architecture, security, data engineering, DevOps, and application leads to ensure the generative AI platform is well\-integrated and aligned with broader enterprise goals **Mentorship:** Mentor and coach AI engineers, helping them grow their technical skills and career paths while fostering a culture of experimentation, humility, and excellence **Engineering Practices:** Ensure strong engineering practices including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and incident response for all services owned by the team **Strategic Planning:** Define and drive strategic plans, goals, and team performance based on company\-wide agentic AI initiatives, balancing near\-term needs with long\-term platform investments **System Design:** Lead collaboration with application teams to understand their needs and design systems which solve complex challenges with reusable components on the agentic AI platform (e.g., LLM orchestration frameworks, experiment tracking, evaluation pipelines, model proxy/gateways, observability, etc.) **Problem Solving:** Work with broad guidelines and technical knowledge to solve highly complex problems with long\-term impacts **Use your skills to make an impact** ===================================== **Required Qualifications** * Advanced degree (Ph.D. or Master’s) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 10\+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role. * Technical Skills: Proficiency in machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch), Python, and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP). * Proven track record of leading and growing high\-performing engineering teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to think strategically and execute methodically. **Additional information** This is a Hybrid office position where employees primarily operate from the company office with occasional work from home to support focus work and work/life balance needs. Designated Tech Market locations for this role: New York City; Louisville, KY; Dallas, TX. **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40**Pay Range** The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $189,400 \- $260,500 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.**Description of Benefits** Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short\-term and long\-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.**About Us** ============ About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. jobs.title: Lead AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= We're seeking a Lead AI Software Engineer to help build the next generation of AI\-powered products and platforms. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role focused on designing, developing, and scaling production\-grade AI solutions that deliver real business impact. This role serves as a key technical resource for customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring data center systems operate efficiently, reliably, and in accordance with established service level agreements (SLAs). The Field Engineer II performs moderate to advanced technical tasks, supports critical infrastructure environments, and may provide guidance to junior technicians and engineers.**Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ + Install, configure, test, and support data center hardware including servers, storage systems, networking equipment, racks, and cabling infrastructure. + Perform preventative maintenance and break\-fix repairs on data center equipment and systems. + Troubleshoot hardware, network connectivity, power, and environmental issues within customer facilities and data centers. + Execute equipment deployments, decommissioning activities, hardware upgrades, and technology refresh projects. + Respond to service requests, incidents, and escalations within established SLA requirements. + Conduct site surveys and assessments to validate installation readiness and identify potential operational risks. + Document service activities, technical findings, asset information, and customer interactions accurately within service management systems. + Coordinate with customers, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional technical teams to resolve complex issues. + Support data center power and cooling infrastructure by performing visual inspections and reporting operational concerns. + Adhere to all safety, security, and compliance requirements while working in customer and data center environments. + Participate in on\-call rotations and provide after\-hours support as required. + Assist with mentoring and training junior field engineers and technicians.**Required Qualifications** --------------------------- + Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. + 3\-5 years of experience supporting data center operations, field services, IT infrastructure, or related technical environments. + Experience installing and troubleshooting servers, storage systems, network devices, and structured cabling. + Working knowledge of Windows and Linux server environments. + Understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals, switching, routing, and connectivity troubleshooting. + Experience using ticketing and service management platforms. + Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and customer service skills. + Ability to lift equipment up to 50 pounds and work in data center environments for extended periods. + Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to customer sites as needed.**Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- + Industry certifications such as: - CompTIA Server\+ - CompTIA Network\+ - Cisco CCNA - Microsoft Certifications - Certified Data Centre Professional (CDCP) + Experience supporting enterprise or hyperscale data center environments. + Knowledge of data center power distribution, UPS systems, and environmental monitoring. + Familiarity with ITIL processes and best practices. + Experience working in mission\-critical or 24x7 operational environments.**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** ---------------------------------- + Strong technical troubleshooting and diagnostic skills. + Ability to interpret technical diagrams, rack elevations, and network documentation. + Excellent verbal and written communication skills. + Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. + Strong customer\-facing and relationship\-building skills. + Capability to work independently with minimal supervision. + Attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.**Working Conditions** ---------------------- + Regular travel to customer and data center locations. + Work may occur in raised\-floor, warehouse, and secure data center environments. + Availability for scheduled maintenance windows, emergency response, and after\-hours support. + Ability to stand, bend, climb ladders, and move equipment throughout the workday. ned. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Hybrid \- Denver **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Technical \- Engineering Ibotta is looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to join our innovative team and contribute to our mission to Make Every Purchase Rewarding by building something great with us. As part of the engineering team, you will work on the technology solutions that power our products that are used by millions of consumers. We're looking for a self\-motivated engineer who has a real passion for building and running large\-scale, fault\-tolerant applications. Success in this role means not only understanding the right solutions and how to build them, but also embracing innovative means of collaborating with and leveraging AI to do so. Every engineer has input into our engineering culture, our products and development processes, and will have a real impact as part of a small, nimble team. This position is located in Denver, Colorado as a hybrid position requiring 3 days in office, (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). Candidates must live in the United States. **What you will be doing:** * Build products and tools, using the right language/tool for the job, that drive valuable impact to Ibotta, our customers, or fellow engineers * Work collaboratively with a highly talented cross\-functional team to design, develop and deliver new products and features that will be used by millions of users * Use Amazon’s AWS infrastructure and advanced services daily, including serverless architectures * Stay abreast of the ever\-changing technology landscape to identify the best tools and technologies to design and build flexible, scalable, reliable and high\-performing applications * Maintain an agile, experimental and iterative approach, with a willingness to learn fast in a constantly evolving and uncertain environment * Decompose complex business problems and requirements into manageable sub\-tasks * Know how to skillfully and judiciously leverage AI to assist with software development * Know when to choose AI as part of the tech stack and how to use it when building products, and operating them in production * Demonstrate leadership by offering guidance to team members, cultivating their technical aptitude, and championing best practices within the development process. * Leverage and contribute to our CI/CD pipeline to deploy code many times daily * Write tests and participate in code reviews to ensure that we're shipping high\-quality, maintainable code, and develop evaluators to verify the quality of non\-deterministic outputs * Own your technical solutions end\-to\-end from contributing your ideas, to first code commit, to operating in production * Embrace and uphold Ibotta’s Core Values: *Integrity, Boldness, Ownership, Teamwork, Transparency, \& A good idea can come from anywhere* **What we are looking for:** * 7\+ years of experience in software development * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics or a related field required * Mastery of relevant technologies such as Typescript, Ruby on Rails, Java, Kotin, Nodejs, Vue, Swift, etc, and data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, Redis, etc. is valuable, but knowing when to use each is far more important * Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, and software architecture. * Deep understanding of building highly scalable, observable, and fault tolerant systems * Mastery of applying core computer science concepts to iterative system design * Highly skilled in using AI tools for prototyping, writing, testing, debugging, and comprehending code, and the ability to critically review and improve AI\-generated code to meet production standards * Proficient in context engineering and AI building blocks such as LLM API calls, prompting techniques, agentic frameworks, RAG, vector databases, and model fine\-tuning * Proven experience with debugging and testing approaches, and frameworks from unit testing to automated testing and evaluation driven development * Proven experience building, deploying and operating automated workflows and agents, using platforms such as n8n, Databricks or similar * Deep understanding of development best practices including observability, alerting and SLOs for services, security, compliance, performance, optimization, reliability, cost efficiency, etc. * Proven experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCloud, or similar and with DevOps best practices and Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g. Terraform) **Some of the traits that we seek in great engineers:** * You…. + love to teach and learn from your co\-workers + look for ways to continually challenge yourself and develop as an engineer + are product\-minded, with a deep capacity to understand your customers, and can determine the right product and design requirements to meet their needs + understand that communication is a huge part of your software engineering responsibility and practice it daily + understand that testing your code is one of the most important aspects of software engineering + respect diverse perspectives and like collaborating with other engineers to solve hard problems + understand that delivering products incrementally helps provide more value to the business + trust your teammates, and embrace healthy conflict and debate. You believe getting it right is more important than being right. **About Ibotta ("I bought a...")** Ibotta (NYSE: IBTA) is a leading performance marketing platform allowing brands to deliver digital promotions to over 200 million consumers through a network of publishers called the Ibotta Performance Network (IPN). The IPN allows marketers to influence what people buy, and where and how often they shop – all while paying only when their campaigns directly result in a sale. American shoppers have earned over $2\.6 billion through the IPN since 2012\. The largest tech IPO in history to come out of Colorado, Ibotta is headquartered in Denver, and is continually listed as a top place to work by The Denver Post and Inc. Magazine. To learn more about what our Tech teams are doing day to day, visit Building Ibotta on Medium.com **Additional Details:** * This position is located in Denver, CO and includes competitive pay, flexible time off, benefits package (including medical, dental, vision), Employee Stock Purchase Program, and 401k match. **Denver office perks include paid parking, snacks, and occasional meals.** * Base compensation range: $160,000 \- $183,000\. Equity is included in overall compensation package. This compensation range is specific to the United States labor market and may be adjusted based on actual experience. * Ibotta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Ibotta’s employment decisions are made without regard of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status. * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. * Applicants are accepted until the position is filled. * For the security of our employees and the business, all employees are responsible for the secure handling of data in accordance with our security policies, identifying and reporting phishing attempts, as well as reporting security incidents to the proper channels. **Recruiting Agency Notice** Ibotta does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to any Ibotta employees.
